On Fri, Nov 2, 2026 at 2:28 PM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Jordan — please confirm whether our marketplace ingestion supports: code, value, expiration, partner_id, and optional metadata field (hubspot_contact_id).

Yes — we support that payload. Requirements:
- CSV columns: code, value_usd, expires_at(ISO8601), partner_id, hubspot_contact_id (optional)
- Max file size 10k rows per upload. For >10k we need batching or SFTP intake.
- Codes must be single-token alphanumeric, no spaces; please avoid special characters.
- We will mark redeemed accounts in our system and emit a webhook to the CloudGate endpoint you register.

I attached voucher_template.csv with the exact header order. If CloudGate is sending >10k codes we’ll set up an SFTP drop and a short cert-exchange (30–60m work).

Jordan Blake
Integration Engineer, Redwood Inference
